main.description: Encrypted per-conversation read-watermark state in the personal mailbox Space for monotonic MAX(readThroughSeq) unread synchronization across sibling devices. rkey = conversationId. Ciphertext is DNDK-GCM sealed under the epoch root key and AAD-bound to account DID, collection, and rkey.

ciphertext.description: DNDK-GCM sealed read-watermark payload under the personal mailbox epoch root key.

epoch.description: Mailbox epoch sequence number whose root key derived the DNDK-GCM key.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this encrypted read watermark was written.
